[EVENT] User is looking for good places to try ramen in Tokyo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tokyo is a ramen lover's paradise, and the assistant provided recommendations for popular ramen spots.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended ramen shops include Ichiran Shibuya, Ippudo, Totto Ramen, Tsuta, Nagi Golden Gai, Afuri, Ramen Nagi, Ramen Kimura, and Ramen Mio.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for ramen include being prepared for long lines, having cash handy, customizing bowls, and slurping noodles.

[EVENT] User is planning to visit the Tsukiji Outer Market while in Tokyo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided information about Tsukiji Outer Market, including its history and what to expect.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tsukiji Outer Market is known for fresh seafood, sushi restaurants, food stalls, street food, and a bustling atmosphere.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting Tsukiji Outer Market include getting there early, being prepared for crowds, having cash, dressing comfortably, and respecting vendors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The nearest station to Tsukiji Outer Market is Tsukiji-shijo Station on the Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line.
